name: takealot
description: A Takealot shopping assistant for product research, reviews, and explicitly confirmed wishlist actions.

interface.longDescription: Search Takealot, inspect product details and images, read review distributions and review samples, and combine that with external research for balanced shopping guidance.
defaultPrompt: Find and compare the best products on Takealot.
Research this Takealot product, including positive and negative reviews.
Give me a balanced shopping brief with Reddit and external sources.
